newsitem.title: TAIWAN: Taiwan stock turnover rockets to record T$269 bln.
newsitem.headline: Taiwan stock turnover rockets to record T$269 bln.

text.p: Turnover in Taiwan's red-hot stock market rocketed to an all-time high T$269.5 billion shortly before Thursday's close, eclipsing the T$262 billion set on Tuesday.
The T$269.5 billion (US$9.6 billion) marked the latest in a yearlong string of eye-popping turnover records that have vaulted Taiwan's stock market into the ranks of the world's most active markets.

The huge turnover has triggered concerns over possible distortion in Taiwan's money and foreign exchange markets, having the effect of siphoning huge flows of liquidity from both markets into the stock market.
Short-term interest rates have been highly volatile during the most recent stock rally, spiking into double digits in late June on a stock rally-induced liquidity squeeze.
